<result>Fixed and merged to main at dc1acdd6 (events committed at 6ec7a0b48). The fix task `fix-Bf540195aec` is completed and closes bug Bf540195aec.

- **Root cause:** `_holder_note` in `ddflow/infra/log.py` read `/proc/locks` once. The kernel serves that file in chunks and it is not a snapshot, so under heavy flock traffic a single read skips a live holder, and the holder section was dropped silently. I reproduced it: 418 of 3000 scans missed a live holder with 40 flock-churning processes running.
- **Fix:** it now rescans (up to 50 scans or 1s) and probes whether the lock is still held. It returns "Holder unknown (...)" instead of silence, and returns "" only when the lock was released. The happy path is unchanged.
- **Regression test:** `test_a_scan_that_misses_the_holder_is_retried_not_silently_dropped` fails on the old code. I also added a test for a holder that exits mid-description. Under churn, 15 runs of the file with `-n 16` were clean after the fix (before it, 1 in 15 failed). The lock-diagnosis and `test_fsio*` tests pass at `-n 8`.
- **Gates:** research, rules, implement, standards, ci (full suite), unit_tests, bug_hunt, dedupe and merge are passed. critic (deepseek-v4-pro) passed on the code head.
- **rubber_duck:** passed only "on refutation": I triaged 3 findings (1 refuted as an accepted risk, 2 confirmed and fixed). The last two commits (the constants-register change and the merge of main) postdate the reviews, and `ddflow complete` printed that warning for rubber_duck and standards.
- **Extras:** I had to register the two new scan-bound constants in `docs/ddflow/constants-exemptions.toml` to pass the constants ratchet. `ddflow complete` also needed `--model claude-sonnet-5-5`. I did not file separate bugs for the stale 0.2.1 server or the two hook-blocked commands I tried by mistake.</result>

Report precision/recall and cost (build time, size). Time box 1 day; stdlib only (D-graph-stdlib). A result that does not beat the current ranking by a clear margin closes the pilot and the idea; a win files a build task. No production code.
